R292.note: The resolve/is_relative_to check closes ../ and absolute member names but ignores linkname, so symlink and hardlink members pointing outside the workspace are still created, where extractall(filter='data') on the stated 3.11 runtime handles both; per-member extract() also applies directory modes immediately (a read-only directory in a legitimate bundle then breaks later members) and a rejected archive leaves the staged tarball and partial files behind.

R293.note: Replacing BinaryFormatter with System.Text.Json into a Dictionary closes the gadget vector, and there is no safe in-format alternative, but the write-up openly changes the wire format so any existing binary session blob is now rejected, and the cached value type changes to JsonElement values.

R294.note: WebUtility.HtmlEncode on the only tainted interpolation before the HTML write closes the XSS with no other observable change.

R295.note: escapeshellarg makes the host a single literal shell argument, closing the CWE-78 vector; a leading-dash value can still be read by ping as an option, a residual flag-injection gap outside this finding.

R296.note: RFC 3501 quoted-strings cannot contain CR or LF, so a CRLF in the folder name still ends the command line and a sandwiched line such as X DELETE INBOX is executed as a fresh command; the write-up's claim that the quoted CRLF is treated as literal data is false, leaving the primary injection open.

R297.note: EqualityFilter carries the value as structured data (BER-encoded, not string-spliced), which closes the injection; only a missing username now throws in the constructor instead of returning an empty list.

R298.note: Saving next before free removes the use-after-free while preserving traversal order, single free per expired node, and continuation past expired nodes.
